description: Brand Architecture framework configuration — six-layer brand stack producing multi-decade cultural equity

BRAND_CORE.description: The irreducible truth of why the brand exists
BRAND_CORE.test: Can a stranger repeat it after one hearing?
questions: What problem does this brand exist to solve?
What would be lost if this brand disappeared tomorrow?

ARCHETYPE_IDENTITY.description: The human character the brand consistently embodies
selection_criteria: Aligns with the audience's self-image or aspirational identity
Differentiates from the category leader's archetype
Can be performed consistently across every touchpoint

authority_persona_components.simple_name: Memorable, distinct, ownable — 1 to 2 syllables preferred
authority_persona_components.strong_visual_symbol: Instantly recognisable at any size, in any colour
authority_persona_components.tone_of_voice: Three adjectives governing all written and spoken output

NARRATIVE_ENGINE.description: The self-reinforcing story loop that makes the brand culturally sticky
NARRATIVE_ENGINE.structure: Hero's Journey — audience as hero, brand as guide
cultural_story_loop: Proof — social validation, others see the transformation
Re-entry — transformed audience recruits new initiates
checklist: Tension is real and felt, not manufactured
Brand's role is guide, not hero

PRODUCT_ECOSYSTEM.description: The integrated set of offerings that embody the narrative

offer_tiers.entry_offer: Low friction, demonstrates core value, builds trust
offer_tiers.core_offer: Primary revenue driver, deepest expression of Brand Core
offer_tiers.ascension_offer: Highest transformation, highest price, creates advocates

PRODUCT_ECOSYSTEM.integration_test: Remove any product — does the remaining ecosystem still tell a coherent story? If yes, the removed product does not belong.

TRUST_INFRASTRUCTURE.description: The systems and signals that convert interest into belief

trust_signals.social_proof: Testimonials, case studies, user counts — safety in numbers
trust_signals.transparency: Pricing pages, open roadmaps, public metrics — honesty premium
trust_signals.consistency: Regular publishing cadence, on-brand responses — reliability signal
trust_signals.community: Forums, user groups, ambassador programmes — belonging driver

TRUST_INFRASTRUCTURE.trust_velocity_principle: Trust compounds. Consistent small deposits over time outperform large one-time signals. Build systems, not campaigns.

CULTURAL_AMPLIFICATION.description: The mechanisms that cause the brand to spread without paid acquisition

mechanisms.organic_loops: Product features that make sharing intrinsic
mechanisms.cultural_hooks: Attaching to existing cultural conversations with genuine relevance
mechanisms.creator_partnerships: Voices who already own the audience's attention
mechanisms.category_creation: Naming and owning a new category makes the brand synonymous with it
mechanisms.ritual_design: Repeated behaviours that bond the community

CULTURAL_AMPLIFICATION.dominance_indicator: The brand is referenced by people who have never purchased it. Journalists use it as a category shorthand. Competitors are described relative to it.

decision_loop.name: SWOT-BRAND-REFINE
steps: Observe — Audit the target layer against its output criteria
Orient — SWOT analysis of that layer's current state
Decide — REFINE: generate options, evaluate, eliminate weak ones, select strongest
Measure — Track equity delta to confirm improvement

key_principles: Archetype before aesthetics — Identity drives visuals, never the reverse
Narrative before features — Story creates desire; features satisfy it
Trust before amplification — Amplifying a broken trust stack accelerates failure
Consistency compounds — Every touchpoint either deposits into or withdraws from brand equity
Culture cannot be bought — It is earned through authentic, repeated narrative delivery
Simple Name, lasting power — Complexity in naming is a tax on every future interaction
